dct_title_s: Atlas antiquus : twelve maps of the ancient world for schools and colleges
dct_description_sm: 1. Orbis terrarum antiquis notus. -- Imperia Persarum et Macedonum. -- 3. Aegyptus ; Phoenice et Palaestina. -- 4. Asia citerior. -- 5. Gallia, Britannia, Germania. -- 12. Imperium Romanum.
